name: vibe-sunsang-codex
description: Codex-native AI collaboration mentor — analyzes local Codex session history with 6-axis skill evaluation (DECOMP/VERIFY/ORCH/FAIL/CTX/META), 7-level system (L1~L7, 0.5 increments), 4 workspace types (Builder/Explorer/Designer/Operator), incremental re-analysis, and longitudinal growth tracking.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze Codex sessions and coach AI collaboration habits
interface.longDescription: Packages the Codex-native vibe-sunsang skill set: onboarding, conversation conversion, retrospectives, mentoring, growth reports, and knowledge-base explanations. It reads local Codex session JSONL files (~/.codex/sessions), groups them by working directory, converts them to Markdown with per-session metrics, and turns them into coaching signals. Re-analysis is incremental (only sessions active since the last review), and growth reports lead with one level headline plus up to three next moves.
